ModMetaData.name: Beetlefleet Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description: Replaces Vanilla Genetics Expanded's GR_Beetlefleet art (south/east/north facings only) with a render generated for this campaign (Cauldron sheet 2026-10-04, owner pick B (east/south; north was rejected and is being redrawn)). LABEL/ART ONLY - no defName touched, no Defs, no Patches, loose Textures/ only, same relative path (Things/Pawn/Animal/AlphaAnimals/Insectoid/GR_Beetlefleet_<facing>) the donor uses so this mod's later load order wins the same-path resolution.
